title: DC-area forecast: Rounds of rain, wind, and thunder today; drying out tomorrow
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: The remnants of Isaias produce wind-swept rain this morning and showers this afternoon with temperatures in the 60s. A few strong to severe thunderstorms and an isolated tornado are possible toward evening.

What’s next? After a cloudy start, partly sunny skies return by Monday afternoon with highs near 70 and a lingering breeze. Warming up Tuesday and Wednesday before a late-week cooldown.

Today’s daily digit — 3/10: Isaias soaks our Sunday, even if rain lets up by afternoon, with gusty breezes and a rumble of thunder. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Sunday): Rain continues fairly steady and heavy at times before tapering to intermittent showers late morning or early afternoon. Temperatures hold in the 60s with gusts from the east near 30 mph. A few thunderstorms with strong to severe winds become possible toward evening, mainly after 5 p.m. That’s when an isolated tornado is possible as well, especially south and southeast of DC. Beware of some ponding on roadways and pay attention to any severe weather alerts. Confidence: Medium

Radar forecast for today

Tonight: The chance for a few strong to severe storms and an isolated tornado continues through around midnight, then cloud cover and a few spotty showers remain overnight. Confidence: Low-Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Columbus Day (Monday): Any lingering showers should finish up by around 9 a.m. Mostly cloudy morning skies give way to partial afternoon clearing with highs in the upper 60s to low 70s. Winds remain somewhat breezy from the northwest with gusts near 25 mph. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Mostly clear as winds diminish during the evening. Dry and comfortable through the night with lows in the upper 50s to near 60. Confidence: High

A look ahead

Abundant sunshine Tuesday and noticeably warmer with highs in the upper 70s to near 80. A spotty shower is possible Tuesday night with lows in the 60s. Confidence: Medium-High

As we approach mid-month, Wednesday looks to be a mostly sunny and pleasant fall day with highs in the mid-70s to near 80. A cold front comes through Wednesday night with lows in the upper 50s to near 60. Confidence: Medium

Partly sunny and turning cooler Thursday with highs in the 60s to near 70. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for October 11

A relentless 2013 storm—fed by tropical remnants and a larger system—dumped record rainfall across the region as part of a sprawling, multi-hazard event.
